title: How engineering teams adopt AI: productivity, measurement and governance
thesis: AI coding tools raise individual throughput on some tasks, but organisation-level gains depend on measurement, review capacity and governance; the evidence on productivity is mixed, not uniformly positive.
audience: Engineering leaders planning AI adoption across their teams
